crossRefs.note: “Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste! Cry, you daughters of Rabbah! Clothe yourself in sackcloth. Lament, and run back…

translations.web: and their king will go into captivity, he and his princes together,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Their king will go into exile — he and his princes together,” says the LORD.
translations.kjv: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: and their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith Jehovah.
